北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天体感凉，多穿衣物，记得补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and feels cool. Dress warmly and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微风，体感舒适。外出散步，心情好！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with a light breeze, feeling comfortable. Enjoy a walk outside!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾气，出门注意安全，湿度大别忘通风。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy. Drive safely, and remember to ventilate your home!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天微暖，湿度较高，注意防潮和开窗通风。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and mild with high humidity. Mind dampness and ventilate!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感舒适。外出游玩，保持愉快心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy and feels pleasant. Have fun outside and stay cheerful!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阵雨，出门带伞，路面湿滑，注意安全哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hanzhou has showers. Take an umbrella, and be careful on wet roads!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷湿度高，穿暖别受凉，保持室内干燥。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cold and humid. Dress warmly, avoid colds, and keep indoors dry.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感微凉。出门添件薄外套，保持好心情。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels slightly cool. Grab a light jacket and stay cheerful!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉风大体感凉，出门加衣，注意防风保暖！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is windy and feels cool. Wear more layers when going out and stay warm!
武汉.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天微凉，体感适中。出门记得添件衣服哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and slightly cool. The weather feels moderate. Remember to add a layer!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天体感凉，早晚温差大，记得加件薄外套。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels cool. Mind the temperature change and add a light jacket.
重庆.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感寒凉，多穿衣物，注意防寒保暖哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels chilly. Dress in layers to stay warm and prevent colds!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感寒冷风力大，注意防风保暖，多喝热水！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels very cold and windy. Bundle up, stay warm, and drink hot water!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明风大体感凉，穿件外套，小心别着凉哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is windy and feels cool. Wear a jacket and be careful not to catch a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾气，能见度低，开车请注意安全，放慢车速！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy with low visibility. Drive safely and slowly!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷湿度高，穿暖别受凉，出行注意安全。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cold and humid. Dress warmly, avoid colds, and travel safely.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天体感寒凉，多穿衣物，注意防寒保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels chilly. Layer up to stay warm and prevent colds!
